mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hot_keyword (keyword, search_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{keyword}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, search_count, updated_at FROM hot_keyword ORDER BY search_count DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
